$comment: Custom Product Pages for MATCH. Edit this file and run the App Store workflow (task: product-pages). Screenshots are numbers 1-6 from ios/App/fastlane/screenshots/en-US, in the order they should show. Each page needs App Review before it goes live.

pages.name: Say it and play
pages.audience: Ads about the AI round builder
pages.promotionalText: Say the course, your group and the bet. MATCH builds the card, scores by voice and settles up when you finish.

pages.name: Betting games
pages.audience: Golfers who play for money: Nassau, skins, Wolf, Vegas
pages.promotionalText: Skins, Nassau, Wolf, Vegas, Sixes and your own house games. Every bet tracked live and netted out at the end.

pages.name: Voice scoring
pages.promotionalText: Say "Sam 3, Jack 4" and keep walking. Net scores, matches and money update as you play.

pages.name: Settle up
pages.audience: Golf trips and regular groups who keep a tab
pages.promotionalText: Who owes who, netted out before you leave the car park. Mark it paid and keep a running tab for your group.
